mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT), which increases ezetimibe metabolism and glucuronidation, significantly reducing ezetimibe plasma concentrations and cholesterol-lowering efficacy.
action: Monitor lipid panel closely and consider increasing ezetimibe dose or using alternative antimycobacterial agents if ezetimibe therapy is essential; therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted.
